sloka: एकमेकेन बाणेन त्रिभिस्त्रीन् दशभिर्दश।लक्ष्मणस्य प्रचिच्छेद दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम् ।। ६.१००.२० ।।
transliteration: ekamekena bāṇena tribhistrīn daśabhirdaśa।lakṣmaṇasya praciccheda darśayan pāṇilāghavam ।। 6.100.20 ।।

translations.english: Exhibiting his skill by hand, he split the arrows of Lakshmana with only one arrow, three with three and ten with ten.
